messages:
Alex W: Noticed gaps in forecast ingest between 03:12-03:18 UTC from eu-west collectors — network jitter caused partial payloads. Putting snippet below for schema mapping impact.
Alex W: ```
ERROR: http read timeout from collector-eu-1: EOF
RECV: {"alloc_id":"a-123","gpu_hours":2.3,"region":"eu-west","net_tags":null}
```
Priya N: Hmm. net_tags null could break grouping in the mapper. Are collectors attaching netflow labels? We added them in the agent last month but maybe not on older VMs.
Mateo R: The aggregator window is 5m. If collector retries send truncated payloads we end up with duplicates or missing metrics. Proposal: add payload checksum and a required 'ingest_version' header, then reject truncated items and surface to backfill queue.
Jing L: For forecasting we need deterministic attribution. Suggest new metric names and units: gpu_active_hours (float), gpu_alloc_count (int), network_tether_ms (int). Update dashboard panels /dashboards/forecast/gpu_headroom to use gpu_active_hours by alloc_id.
Priya N: Also add netflow.source and netflow.dst tags to mapper so we can partition by NIC pair. Quick mapper snippet:
Priya N: ```json
{"map": [{"src_field":"netflow.src","target":"net_src"}, {"src_field":"alloc_id","target":"allocation"}, {"src_field":"gpu_hours","target":"gpu_active_hours"}] }
```
Mateo R: Backfill plan: run a short replay for 03:00-04:00 with dedupe by (alloc_id,timestamp,checksum). I'll add a k8s job. ops-bot: can we queue a backfill ticket?
ops-bot: backfill-job created #INC-4521 — queued with priority medium. Link: https://tasks.internal/INC-4521
Alex W: Can we also add a passive metric for 'payload_truncated' count to alerts? If it spikes > 5 in 10m trigger p1.
Jing L: I'll update the forecast ETL schema and write unit tests for ingestion + sample payloads. Will push a PR to infra/forecast-ingest later today.
Priya N: I'll coordinate with EU infra to rotate collectors and verify agent version across VMs. sounds good :thumbsup: 
Mateo R: ETA for backfill run: today 20:00 UTC. I'll post start/finish logs.
Alex W: Thanks — tagging @Priya N @Jing L for follow-ups. Closing thread after backfill.
